text:
Anna (Docs): heads-up — three docs PRs touching the feature-flagged `adaptive-batching` pages need to land before v1.5.0 ship. Cutoff is Thu 2026-04-01 23:59 PT. PRs: #345, #346, #347. Can we coordinate reviewers + merge timing?
Samir (Eng): I can take the technical review on #345 and #346 tomorrow morning. Are the code samples final? I saw a small API rename in the runtime PR.
Anna (Docs): good point — runtime changed `batch_size_hint` -> `batch_hint`. I updated the examples in #345 but left #347 as a placeholder (migration guide).
Marie (Product): need to make sure the product note about GA vs gated rollout is accurate — hold on merge until I sign off on the rollout wording. ETA for me: EOD Wed.
Jon (Release): FYI release window is Fri 2026-04-02 09:00–11:00 PT. We prefer docs merged before the build that cuts the release candidate at 08:30 PT. If anything slips, we can still merge post-RC but with a patch release.
Samir (Eng): OK I'll prioritize. Quick one: in the Python snippet we should switch from `client.generate(..., batch_hint=32)` to the new named param `batch_hint` — I can push a tiny change to #345 if that's easier.
Anna (Docs): please do that in a follow-up commit on #345. For process: would prefer reviewers add `docs-ready` label and me or @jon do a `merge-on-green` during the merge window. Also need the docs preview URL for product to review wording.
Ben (CI): deploy preview built for PRs. Links: #345 https://deploy-preview.rw-inference.com/pr-345, #346 https://deploy-preview.rw-inference.com/pr-346, #347 https://deploy-preview.rw-inference.com/pr-347 — status: all green except lint warnings on #347.
docs-bot: Lint check: trailing whitespace in docs/v1.5/migration.md line 42 (PR #347).
Anna (Docs): thanks @docs-bot — I'll fix the trailing whitespace on #347 this afternoon. Marie, once you sign off on wording, can you drop an approval? Then Samir + one more technical approve needed (preferably from infra or eng-platform).
Marie (Product): will review previews after the wording fix. If it's just the rollout phrase, I can approve by Thu morning.
Samir (Eng): pinging @eng-platform for second technical review — @michelle? (not in thread). If we can't get another approver, Jon can grant exception for non-blocking docs changes during the RC window.
Jon (Release): I'd rather avoid exceptions. If second tech review isn't available, we'll queue the PRs and merge them in the first post-RC patch window (Fri 12:30–13:30 PT) unless product insists on earlier.
Anna (Docs): proposed plan: 1) Samir merges fixes into #345/#346 today; 2) Anna fixes #347 lint + adds migration snippet; 3) Marie approves by Thu morning; 4) Merge-on-green between 08:45–09:00 PT Fri so changes are in RC build. If any blocker, move to patch window.
Samir (Eng): sounds good. I'll open a tiny commit for the param rename in #345 now.
Ben (CI): new preview for #345 is up: https://deploy-preview.rw-inference.com/pr-345?v=2 — build passed.
Anna (Docs): updated #347 to remove trailing whitespace and added the quick migration snippet. Pinged Marie.
Marie (Product): reviewed previews. wording tweak in migration section suggested (small sentence edit). Approved after that.
Samir (Eng): gave technical approval on #345 and #346.
Anna (Docs): all approvals collected (product + tech). I'll coordinate merge-on-green with @jon to execute between 08:45–09:00 PT Fri. Please avoid force pushes to those branches after 08:30 PT.
Jon (Release): confirmed. I'll watch for the merges and verify the RC build includes the updated docs. If anything goes wrong, we follow fallback: revert + patch.
Anna (Docs): thanks everyone — marking this thread resolved. Will post a quick post-merge note in #release-war-room once green. :party-parrot:
